name: English Heritage Gardens: SAM and Preference
description: Faithful replication with the original scenes: participants first answer the paper's background questionnaire, then see 10 English heritage gardens and parks from the National Heritage List for England (Nymans, Saltram, Killerton, Tyntesfield, Attingham Park, Sissinghurst Castle, Scotney Castle, Prior Park and Lyme Park) in random order. Each scene is shown as the paper's three consecutive Google Street View frames from a clockwise spin (8 s each, 24 s in total, like the paper's 24 s clips); participants then rate it with the Self-Assessment Manikin for pleasure (valence) and arousal, 1-9, and give an aesthetic preference rating from 1 (Strongly Dislike) to 10 (Strongly Like). Rebuilt from Zhang, Han & Shen (2025), Real-Time Sensor-Based and Self-Reported Emotional Perceptions of Urban Green-Blue Spaces: Exploring Gender Differences with FER and SAM, Sensors 25(3): 748, with the scene frames from its Figure S2, the manikin pictures and SAM wording from its Questionnaire S3 and the background items from Questionnaire S1 (supplementary materials, CC BY 4.0; the frames are Google Street View imagery). Scene ids are the paper's labels C1-C19 (odd numbers; _1 to _3 = frames). Analysis as in the paper: mean valence, arousal and preference per scene by gender (t-tests) and their correlation with the scenes' visual variables (green view index, trees, grass, water, sky, buildings); the paper reports women felt more pleasant and preferred high-arousal scenes, while men preferred scenes with peak valence. Differences from the original study: (1) the paper's self-report group saw static GSV panoramas; here each scene is the three frames shown one after another; (2) the Japanese auxiliary scenes (used to break up the British ones) and the facial-expression-recognition experiment are not included; (3) the name item of the background questionnaire is left out; (4) the wording of the arousal anchors follows the paper's Questionnaire S3 but refers to 'this scene' rather than 'the panoramic video'.
author: Zhang, Han & Shen
